defects: Assignment learner could change despite a recorded response
Recorded response could be reassigned to another assignment or question
Assignment course could change after all responses archived, mismatching historical question course

before_fix.archived_question_edit_error: Утверждённую запись нельзя менять. Создайте новую версию.
before_fix.existing_guard_note: Archived responses already protected the question text/answer/course; this was a passing control, not a new defect

policy: Recorded response keeps assignment and question identity. Any recorded response, including archived, protects assignment course and learner. Deadline edits, unarchived answer-text corrections, explicit archive/retry and movement of assignments without responses remain available. Legacy archived mismatches restore unchanged without silent repair or unrelated-work freeze.

coverage: learner/course guards with live and archived responses; question protection retained
recorded response cannot switch assignment/question; rejected operations preserve full state/revision/audit
answer-text correction and explicit archive/new attempt remain available; archived record read-only; live duplicate rejected
deadline edit and empty assignment/course/learner move allowed
real file close/reopen, validated empty-database restore and legacy archived mismatch retained without automatic repair
original HTTP auth/CSRF/cookie/conflict tests remain passing

browser.readback: Reload then Show archive:2 original responses retain original learner, questions and answer; original assignment retains course/learner with changed deadline; empty assignment moved to other course

limits: Working journal with visible answer key, not an exam or evidence of skill mastery
No immutable snapshots of entire course material and no external LMS integration
Old mistaken associations are not automatically corrected; require separate manual reconciliation
UI layout/schema unchanged; no fresh whole-interface/security audit
Server checked locally; no public server deployment/customer acceptance
